u(x,y)=K(x,y)\,\psi(D^{-
u}d(x,y))$ for $

Each tile $\mathfrak p\in\mathfrak P$ has a cube $\mathcal I(\mathfrak p)\in\mathrm{Grid}(X)$, with $c(\mathfrak p):=c(\mathcal I(\mathfrak p))$ and $s(\mathfrak p):=s(\mathcal I(\mathfrak p))$, an element $\mathcal Q(\mathfrak p)\in\Theta(X)$ and a set $\Omega(\mathfrak p)\subseteq\Theta(X)$. According to its docstring, it is the set $\mathcal J'$ defined at the start of Section 7.6, given a different name to distinguish it from the $\mathcal J'$ used in Section 7.5.
